title: The Burnt Contact
author: Coral Brightwater
blurb: Mirabel Okafor, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
